purpose.summary: This is a batch/interactive accounting card input program (component J02) of the ORCA JMA Standard Receipt Software, a Japanese medical association open-source medical billing system. It handles patient insurance accounting card entry, including patient lookup, insurance combination management, treatment history, and hospitalization records. The program reads/writes SPA (screen parameter area) files and calls numerous subprograms for data retrieval and update.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims processing)

verdict.notes: The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) project. Japanese comments are present but appear garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The source is clearly production-grade medical billing software. All four COBOL divisions are present. The 276KB file with 6706 lines and extensive COPY statements is consistent with a large production COBOL program. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being a financial/billing application, which is somewhat unusual but consistent with GnuCOBOL usage on Linux.
